Bundled offline XLSX dependencies

pako 1.0.11: pako_inflate.min.js
Source: https://github.com/nodeca/pako
Copied unchanged from the runtime-installed pako/dist/pako_inflate.min.js.
License: pako-LICENSE.txt (MIT and zlib)
Used only for bounded raw DEFLATE decompression. No network requests.

sax 1.6.1: sax.js
Source: https://github.com/isaacs/sax-js
Copied unchanged from the runtime-installed sax/lib/sax.js.
License: sax-LICENSE.txt (Blue Oak Model License 1.0.0)
Used for strict XML parsing with DTD and entity declarations rejected by xlsx_import.js.

These files are embedded in om_demo.html by the build scripts so the demo can run offline.
